name: ribbon-yard-equipment
about: A sound square ad: a white tractor at a fuel island at night. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `ribbon` look (centred Anton headline, pill button, a hairline over the legal line): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-yard-equipment`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: a night scene, the truck legible, the kit's colours

subject_legible.reason: A white semi-truck cab is clearly visible at a fuel stop, instantly readable as a tractor at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline calls for OTR drivers and the picture shows a semi-truck at a fuel stop — a quintessential OTR scene that reinforces the message well.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The bold white headline dominates immediately, the pill-shaped 'Apply Now' button reads clearly beneath it, and the green overlay keeps the truck from competing with the text.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep green overlay and white text match the two stated brand colours exactly, though no logo is present to reinforce the carrier identity further.
